SIX CELEBRATIONS · FOUR LOOKS

Outfit inspiration for every celebration, so packing for Jaipur is easy. Events that run into each other share one look, so you only need four outfits. Only the Haldi has a colour theme. The pictures are only here to spark ideas, so please wear whatever colours make you happy. The Haldi is the one fun exception!

DRESS CODEGLITZ & GLAMOUR

From the Godh Teeka to the last song at the after party, it is one long night of sparkle. Dress once, dance all night.

FOR HER
  • Sequinned or embellished sarees
  • Shimmer lehengas & cocktail gowns
  • Statement earrings
FOR HIM
  • Velvet or embroidered bandhgalas
  • Tuxedos & Indo-western sets
  • Embellished jackets over kurtas
STYLE NOTENo need to change for the after party. Keep comfortable shoes handy for the dance floor, and a stole or jacket for the lawn after sunset.

ONE LOOK · 4 EVENTS

DRESS CODEGRAND TRADITIONAL

Family blessings, a dancing Baraat, the Varmala and the sacred Pheras: one evening, one look. Wear your most beautiful traditional outfit.

FOR HER
  • Lehengas or heavy sarees
  • Kanjeevaram or Banarasi silks
  • Heirloom jewellery
FOR HIM
  • Sherwanis or achkans
  • Bandhgalas with churidar
  • A stole, dushala or pashmina
STYLE NOTEIt runs from 5 PM to past midnight, from dancing at the Baraat to sitting through the Pheras on an open lawn. Wear shoes you can dance in and bring a warm shawl.

GOOD TO KNOW

Before you pack

FOUR LOOKS, NOT SIX

Events that run into each other share one outfit: Godh Teeka through the after party, and Sehra Bandhi through the Pheras.

SUNNY DAYS, CHILLY NIGHTS

December in Jaipur is pleasant in the afternoon and cold after dark. Pack a layer for both evenings.

LOTS OF LAWNS

The Haldi, Sangeet, Varmala and Pheras are outdoors on lawns. Block heels, juttis and flats are your friends.

HALDI HAPPENS

Turmeric stains. Wear something for the Haldi that you'll love in photos and won't mourn later.

ANANTA SPA & RESORT

THE VENUE

Ananta Spa & Resort

JAIPUR, RAJASTHAN

Sprawling green lawns, courtyards and banquet halls. The Haldi, Sangeet and Pheras are all out on the lawns, so plan for grass underfoot and cool evenings.
